subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘EARTH’ is written as ‘AERHT’ and ‘VENUS’ is written as ‘EVNSU’. How will ‘PLANT’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First two letters → Interchanged positions
 
• Third letter → No change
 
• Last two letters → Interchanged positions

So,

 
• ‘EARTH’ is written as ‘AERHT’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d196b5f85ff41ed94a612a1759136cb1cda438855262c879be226d82a6351af6.png] 

And,

 
• ‘VENUS’ is written as ‘EVNSU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66e3ea82253c488053e509e37700bac0ebbf65cd90b3b1b539acca3da01b7e2d.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘PLANT’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6f80b158f923f7d093e88e11c655693e55ac3087ce3e0e33f8af0cfa34d46ac.png] 

​Hence, "**LPATN**" is the correct answer.

45
